results.title: Adaptive Control of Robot Manipulators With Uncertain Kinematics and Dynamics
results.snippet: In this paper, we investigate the adaptive control problem for robot manipulators with both the uncertain kinematics and dynamics. We propose two adaptive control schemes to realize the objective of task-space trajectory tracking irrespective of the uncertain kinematics and dynamics. The proposed controllers have the desirable separation property, and we also show that the first adaptive controller with appropriate modifications can yield improved performance, without the expense of conservative gain choice. The performance of the proposed controllers is shown by numerical simulations.

results.title: Analysis and design of model predictive control frameworks for dynamic operation -- An overview
results.snippet: This article provides an overview of model predictive control (MPC) frameworks for dynamic operation of nonlinear constrained systems. Dynamic operation is often an integral part of the control objective, ranging from tracking of reference signals to the general economic operation of a plant under online changing time-varying operating conditions. We focus on the particular challenges that arise when dealing with such more general control goals and present methods that have emerged in the literature to address these issues. The goal of this article is to present an overview of the state-of-th…

results.title: The Role of Domain Randomization in Training Diffusion Policies for Whole-Body Humanoid Control
results.snippet: Humanoids have the potential to be the ideal embodiment in environments designed for humans. Thanks to the structural similarity to the human body, they benefit from rich sources of demonstration data, e.g., collected via teleoperation, motion capture, or even using videos of humans performing tasks. However, distilling a policy from demonstrations is still a challenging problem. While Diffusion Policies (DPs) have shown impressive results in robotic manipulation, their applicability to locomotion and humanoid control remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate how dataset diversity…

results.title: Control of a Rigid Wing Pumping Airborne Wind Energy System in all Operational Phases
results.snippet: The control design of an airborne wind energy system with rigid aircraft, vertical take-off and landing, and pumping operation is described. A hierarchical control structure is implemented, in order to address all operational phases: take-off, transition to power generation, pumping energy generation cycles, transition to hovering, and landing. Control design at all hierarchical levels is described. The design approach is conceived and developed with real-world applicability as main driver. Aircraft design considerations in light of system maneuverability are presented, too, as well as three…

results.title: TID System for Speech-COSER Challenge 2026: ASR Track
results.snippet: We describe the system submitted by Telefónica Innovación Digital to the Speech-COSER Challenge 2026, which features spontaneous speech from elderly speakers recorded in rural Spain. For ASR, we perform CTC-based pseudo-forced alignment scores audio-text match quality to guide a two-stage LoRA curriculum, followed by post-hoc magnitude pruning of the LoRA matrices to enhance generalization. An ensemble of seven systems combined via ROVER achieves 36.25\% unnormalized and 22.17\% normalized WER.

report_md:
# 机器人运动学、控制与 ROS 2 生态：2024-2026 年七维增量快照

**日期**：2026-11-16（UTC） | **领域**：具身智能 / 机器人运动学与控制 / ROS 2 工程栈 | **检索源数量**：35 条（含 11 条高相关文献）

> **说明**：本报告严格基于提供的 35 条证据源编号 [1]-[2] 撰写。所有论断均标注引用编号；无直接证据处标注 `> 待核实`。关键术语、模型名、论文标题、库名保留英文原文。

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 全身控制与扩散策略
- **最新进展**：2024 年提出面向全身人形机器人控制的扩散策略训练方法，研究域随机化在从演示数据蒸馏策略中的作用 [3]。该工作利用域随机化提升扩散策略在全身人形控制任务中的泛化能力，解决从遥操作/动捕/视频演示中学习策略的挑战 [3]。
- **表达性全身控制**：2024 年发布 *Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots*，实现人形机器人富有表现力的全身运动控制 [4]。
- **热度证据**：[3] 为 2024 年 arXiv 预印本；[4] 为 2024 年 arXiv 预印本 v2。
- **权威证据**：均为 arXiv 预印本 (cs.RO)，未经同行评审 [3][4]。
- **关注度**：中——人形全身控制为当前热点方向，但均为预印本阶段 [3][4]。
- **推荐度**：★★★☆☆——紧扣全身控制与扩散策略前沿，需跟踪会议录用情况 [3]。

### 1.2 模型预测控制理论与实践
- **MPC 框架综述**：2024 年更新的综述 *Analysis and design of model predictive control frameworks for dynamic operation -- An overview* 系统梳理非线性约束系统在时变工况下的参考信号跟踪与经济最优运行 MPC 设计 [5]。
- **仿真到现实桥接**：2025 年工作 *Bridging the Sim-to-real Gap: A Control Framework for Imitation Learning of Model Predictive Control* 提出通过模仿学习缩小 MPC 的 Sim-to-real 差距 [6]。
- **NMPC 虚拟传感器框架**：2025/2026 年提出预测虚拟传感器辨识框架，针对直驱机械臂解决建模精度与不可测状态变量问题，在 2-DoF 平台验证 [7]。
- **实时学习 LQR**：2024 年 *FRIDAY* 提出基于 DNN 的实时稳定 LQR 控制器，应对非线性系统不确定扰动 [8]。
- **热度证据**：[5] 为 Allgöwer 团队权威综述 v2 (2024-01)；[6] [7] [8] 均为 2024-2025 年 arXiv 预印本。
- **权威证据**：[5] 作者为 MPC 领域权威；[6][7][8] 为预印本，未经同行评审。

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

### 4.1 算法与计算瓶颈
- **NMPC 实时求解延迟**：非线性 MPC 在复杂非线性系统中面临建模精度与不可测状态变量双重挑战，高自由度下实时求解算力为核心瓶颈 [7][5]。
- **PVSID 框架局限**：虚拟传感器仅在 2-DoF 直驱臂验证，推广至人形/灵巧手高维本体时标定成本与泛化性未知 [7]。
- **Sim-to-real 差距**：MPC 仿真策略迁移真机仍需模仿学习桥接，数据效率与鲁棒性待提升 [6]。

### 4.2 运动学与控制理论瓶颈
- **奇异性鲁棒性**：运动学奇异性在全身控制中仍为难点，WBC 公式化对比 [9] 显式处理奇异性的方案有限。
- **安全与性能权衡**：基于 CBF 的安全控制 [10] 与高性能 MPC/RL 的融合在复杂接触任务中缺乏统一理论框架。

### 4.3 工程化与基建瓶颈
- **ROS 2 确定性调度**：尽管 [11] 综述实时进展，但 ros2_control 硬件抽象层标准化、跨厂商驱动兼容性、微秒级确定性调度在生产级部署中仍为痛点 [11][12]。
- **Micro-ROS 资源受限落地**：Budget-based Executor [12] 解决调度，但工具链成熟度、中间件开销在极低功耗 MCU 上仍受限。

### 4.4 拐点信号
- **虚拟传感器范式**：PVSID [7] 若能在 ≥7-DoF 机械臂/人形上复现，将引发“低成本传感器+高保真模型”部署范式转换（**拐点候选**）。
- **扩散策略+域随机化**：[3] 若在多任务、多本体上泛化，可能推动“数据为中心”取代“模型调参”成为主流（**拐点候选**）。
- **ROS 2 实时认证**：若 ROS 2 核心中间件通过功能安全认证（ISO 26262/ISO 13849），将打开工业/车载规模化落地闸门（**政策/标准驱动拐点**，> 待核实）。
